source_provenance: ProofFlow v2.0.0-improved dataset (683 samples, 28 raw classes)

ORDER_PLACED.justification: Approved canonical commerce event representing order placement or confirmation.

PAYMENT_MADE.justification: Approved canonical commerce event representing successful debit or payment settlement.

PAYMENT_FAILED.justification: Approved canonical commerce event representing payment rejection or failure.

REFUND_REQUESTED.justification: Approved canonical commerce event representing customer claim or refund demand.

REFUND_INITIATED.justification: Approved canonical commerce event representing refund processing start.

REFUND_COMPLETED.justification: Approved canonical commerce event representing successful refund payout / ledger credit.

REFUND_FAILED.justification: Approved canonical commerce event representing refund rejection or reversal failure.

ORDER_CANCELLED.justification: Approved canonical delivery event representing order cancellation or voiding.

ITEM_SHIPPED.justification: Approved canonical delivery event representing dispatch or handover to courier.

DELIVERY_ATTEMPTED.justification: Approved canonical delivery event representing failed or attempted courier drop-off.

ITEM_DELIVERED.justification: Approved canonical delivery event representing final receipt or verified parcel drop.

RETURN_REQUESTED.justification: Approved canonical delivery event representing customer return or RMA request.

RETURN_PICKED_UP.justification: Approved canonical delivery event representing courier return item collection.

RETURN_COMPLETED.justification: Approved canonical delivery event representing return item warehouse receipt / inspection.

MESSAGE_SENT.justification: Approved canonical communication event representing outbound message dispatch.

MESSAGE_RECEIVED.justification: Approved canonical communication event representing inbound message receipt.

SUPPORT_CONTACTED.justification: Approved canonical communication event representing escalation or customer support ticket opening.

SUPPORT_RESPONSE.justification: Approved canonical communication event representing agent support reply or ticket update.

ORDER_SHIPPED.justification: Direct synonym for package dispatch; maps cleanly to ITEM_SHIPPED.
ORDER_SHIPPED.recommended_training_action: Map to ITEM_SHIPPED with raw label preserved in sample provenance.

ORDER_DELIVERED.justification: Direct synonym for package delivery; maps cleanly to ITEM_DELIVERED.
ORDER_DELIVERED.recommended_training_action: Map to ITEM_DELIVERED with raw label preserved in sample provenance.

ITEM_RECEIVED.justification: Recipient confirmation of physical receipt is semantically equivalent to delivery completion.
ITEM_RECEIVED.recommended_training_action: Map to ITEM_DELIVERED with raw label preserved in sample provenance.

RETURN_INITIATED.justification: Buyer initiation of return workflow aligns with RETURN_REQUESTED.
RETURN_INITIATED.recommended_training_action: Map to RETURN_REQUESTED with raw label preserved in sample provenance.

REFUND_APPROVED.justification: Administrative authorization milestone prior to financial initiation. Forcing it to REFUND_INITIATED or REFUND_COMPLETED conflates authorization with execution.
REFUND_APPROVED.recommended_training_action: Preserve in dataset provenance as legacy label. Exclude from 18-class classifier loss or assign to auxiliary merchant approval workflow.

REFUND_PROCESSED.justification: Gateway transfer execution step. Forcing to REFUND_INITIATED or REFUND_COMPLETED collapses distinct financial gateway states.
REFUND_PROCESSED.recommended_training_action: Preserve in dataset provenance as legacy label. Exclude from 18-class classifier loss.

REFUND_RECEIVED.justification: Customer credit receipt on bank statement. Collapsing into REFUND_COMPLETED blurs customer-side settlement verification with merchant ledger status.
REFUND_RECEIVED.recommended_training_action: Preserve in dataset provenance as legacy label. Exclude from 18-class classifier loss.

DISPUTE_OPENED.justification: Formal dispute/claim filing on payment platform. Governed by dispute resolution rules (Track 2 Claims), not standard 3-party commercial fulfillment/communication events.
DISPUTE_OPENED.recommended_training_action: Preserve in dataset provenance as dispute domain label. Exclude from 18-class event classifier; train separately in Track 2 Claim/Dispute reasoning.

CHARGEBACK_REQUESTED.justification: Cardholder bank chargeback demand. Legal card-network arbitration mechanism, semantically distinct from merchant refund or commercial payment events.
CHARGEBACK_REQUESTED.recommended_training_action: Preserve in dataset provenance as dispute domain label. Exclude from 18-class event classifier; route to Track 2 Claim/Dispute reasoning.

NO_EVENT.justification: Negative non-event text to enforce non-event rejection in binary & multiclass heads.
NO_EVENT.recommended_training_action: Retained as explicit negative class (Class 19) in DeBERTa classifier.
